name: manual_4641b9
claim: Headless agy cannot read files: the shell permission is auto-denied and the run hangs or prints nothing; inline the diff in the prompt, forbid tools, run read-only under a hard timeout. The Gemini CLI is retired for individuals, so agy is the direct-binary reviewer.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: first agy runs produced nothing until the diff was inlined; gemini exited with an ineligible-tier error and the operator confirmed it was replaced by Antigravity.
